ui.switching_servers_restarts_the_game_y.en: Switching servers restarts the game. Your village stays on this device either way.

ui.tactic_send_saboteurs_first_to_jam_de.en: Tactic: send Saboteurs first to jam defenses, then the main force; throw smoke over your warriors as they walk into tower range.
ui.tactic_send_saboteurs_first_to_jam_de.text: Mbinu: tuma Wahujumu kwanza kukwamisha ulinzi, kisha jeshi kuu; rusha moshi juu ya wapiganaji wako wanapoingia kwenye masafa ya mnara.

ui.tap_inside_a_glowing_ring_to_send_you.text: Gusa ndani ya pete inayong'aa ili kutuma wapiganaji wako ndani. Mishale iliyo pembeni inaelekeza kwenye pete zaidi.

ui.tap_on_the_grass_outside_the_red_area.en: Tap on the grass outside the red area to send your warriors in.
ui.tap_on_the_grass_outside_the_red_area.text: Gusa nyasi nje ya eneo jekundu ili kutuma wapiganaji wako ndani.

ui.tap_update_to_get_the_newest_version_.en: Tap Update to get the newest version. You can also copy a save code to open the village on another device.
ui.tap_update_to_get_the_newest_version_.text: Gonga Sasisha ili kupata toleo jipya zaidi. Unaweza pia kunakili msimbo wa hifadhi ili kufungua kijiji kwenye kifaa kingine.

ui.tap_where_your_warriors_are_about_to_.en: Tap where your warriors are about to come under fire: warriors inside the smoke can only be shot from close up.
ui.tap_where_your_warriors_are_about_to_.text: Gusa mahali wapiganaji wako wanapokaribia kushambuliwa: wapiganaji walio ndani ya moshi wanaweza kupigwa tu kutoka karibu.

ui.testing_sandbox_a_separate_practice_v.en: Testing sandbox: a separate practice village with testing tools and a free test store. Your real village is untouched, and online play is off.
ui.testing_sandbox_a_separate_practice_v.text: Eneo la majaribio: kijiji tofauti cha mazoezi chenye zana za majaribio na duka la majaribio la bure. Kijiji chako halisi hakiguswi, na kucheza mtandaoni kumezimwa.

ui.texture_preparation_failed_the_scenes.en: Texture preparation failed; the scenes paint what is missing

ui.the_full_list_of_keep_unlocks_is_on_t.text: Orodha kamili ya vifunguliwa vya Ngome iko kwenye Ngome ya Ukoo: igonge, kisha "Kile ngazi inayofuata inafungua".

ui.the_home_screen_app_keeps_its_own_vil.en: The Home Screen app keeps its own village, apart from Safari’s. To bring yours here: open Kagemura in Safari, go to Settings → Copy save code, then come back and use Settings → Load from code.
ui.the_home_screen_app_keeps_its_own_vil.text: Programu ya Skrini ya Mwanzo ina kijiji chake, tofauti na cha Safari. Kuleta chako hapa: fungua Kagemura kwenye Safari, nenda Mipangilio → Nakili msimbo wa hifadhi, kisha urudi na utumie Mipangilio → Pakia kutoka msimbo.

ui.the_item_is_delivered_at_once_by_buyi.en: The item is delivered at once; by buying you agree that you lose the right to cancel, as the law allows for digital content.
ui.the_item_is_delivered_at_once_by_buyi.text: Bidhaa huwasilishwa mara moja; kwa kununua unakubali kwamba unapoteza haki ya kughairi, kama sheria inavyoruhusu kwa maudhui ya kidijitali.

ui.the_league_season_ended_your_chest_wa.en: The league season ended: your chest was added. See Honor for details.
ui.the_league_season_ended_your_chest_wa.text: Msimu wa ligi umeisha: kasha lako limeongezwa. Angalia Heshima kwa maelezo.

ui.the_new_version_could_not_be_download.en: The new version could not be downloaded right now. Check your connection and try again.
ui.the_new_version_could_not_be_download.text: Toleo jipya halikuweza kupakuliwa sasa hivi. Angalia muunganisho wako kisha ujaribu tena.

ui.the_next_alliance_war_starts_in_and_l.en: The next Alliance War starts in {arg1} and lasts {arg2} days. Every member gets {arg3} attacks; the best stars on each enemy base add up, and the Alliance with more stars wins.
ui.the_next_alliance_war_starts_in_and_l.text: Vita vya Muungano vinavyofuata vinaanza baada ya {arg1} na vinadumu siku {arg2}. Kila mwanachama anapata mashambulio {arg3}; nyota bora kwenye kila kambi ya adui hujumlishwa, na Muungano wenye nyota nyingi zaidi hushinda.

ui.the_raider_held_this_rematch_is_used_.en: The raider held. This rematch is used up.
ui.the_raider_held_this_rematch_is_used_.text: Mvamizi amestahimili. Mechi hii ya marudiano imetumika.

ui.the_squad_courtyards_are_spoken_for_t.en: The Squad Courtyards are spoken for: train ahead for the next army
ui.the_squad_courtyards_are_spoken_for_t.text: Viwanja vya Kikosi vimeshajazwa: funza mapema kwa jeshi linalofuata

ui.the_store_could_not_be_reached_for_pr.en: The store could not be reached for prices. Check your connection and open the Store again.
ui.the_store_could_not_be_reached_for_pr.text: Duka halikuweza kufikiwa kupata bei. Angalia muunganisho wako kisha ufungue Duka tena.

ui.the_store_shows_the_final_price_inclu.en: The store shows the final price, including any taxes, before you pay.
ui.the_store_shows_the_final_price_inclu.text: Duka huonyesha bei ya mwisho, pamoja na kodi zozote, kabla ya kulipa.

ui.the_training_dojo_researches_a_higher.en: The Training Dojo researches {arg1} (a higher Clan Keep opens more research lanes). A new level makes every warrior of that kind stronger, and costs a little more to train. Your Clan Keep level sets the highest level.
ui.the_training_dojo_researches_a_higher.text: Dojo ya Mafunzo inafanya utafiti wa {arg1} (Ngome ya Ukoo ya juu zaidi hufungua mistari zaidi ya utafiti). Ngazi mpya humwimarisha kila mpiganaji wa aina hiyo, na gharama ya kufunza huongezeka kidogo. Ngazi ya Ngome yako ya Ukoo huweka ngazi ya juu kabisa.

ui.their_full_training_cost_comes_back_a.en: Their full training cost comes back, as far as your storage allows.
ui.their_full_training_cost_comes_back_a.text: Gharama yao kamili ya mafunzo inarudi, kadiri hifadhi yako inavyoruhusu.

ui.there_is_no_online_account_on_this_de.en: There is no online account on this device: your village is kept only here. "Start a new village" below erases it; uninstalling the app or clearing this site's data removes it completely.
ui.there_is_no_online_account_on_this_de.text: Hakuna akaunti ya mtandaoni kwenye kifaa hiki: kijiji chako kinahifadhiwa hapa tu. "Anzisha kijiji kipya" hapa chini kinakifuta; kuondoa programu au kufuta data ya tovuti hii kunakiondoa kabisa.

ui.they_are_under_fire_pick_the_smoke_bo.en: They are under fire! Pick the Smoke Bomb, then tap on your warriors.
ui.they_are_under_fire_pick_the_smoke_bo.text: Wanashambuliwa! Chagua Bomu la Moshi, kisha gusa juu ya wapiganaji wako.

ui.they_fight_first_in_your_next_attack_.en: They fight first in your next attack and take no Courtyard space.
ui.they_fight_first_in_your_next_attack_.text: Wanapigana kwanza katika shambulio lako linalofuata na hawachukui nafasi ya Uwanja.

ui.they_go_home_for_good_you_get_back_of.en: They go home for good. You get back {arg1}% of their training cost, as far as your storage allows.
ui.they_go_home_for_good_you_get_back_of.text: Wanarudi nyumbani kabisa. Unarudishiwa {arg1}% ya gharama yao ya mafunzo, kadiri hifadhi yako inavyoruhusu.

ui.they_walk_in_by_themselves_after_a_ra.en: {arg1} They walk in by themselves after a raid, or when you dismiss warriors.
ui.they_walk_in_by_themselves_after_a_ra.text: {arg1} Wanaingia wenyewe baada ya uvamizi, au unapoachisha wapiganaji.

ui.they_will_be_able_to_invite_and_to_st.en: They will be able to invite and to start Gang Wars. You stay in the Gang.
ui.they_will_be_able_to_invite_and_to_st.text: Ataweza kualika na kuanzisha Vita vya Genge. Wewe unabaki katika Genge.

ui.this_browser_can_t_save_your_village_.en: This browser can't save your village: progress is lost when this page closes. Use a normal (not private) window, or copy a save code in Settings.
ui.this_browser_can_t_save_your_village_.text: Kivinjari hiki hakiwezi kuhifadhi kijiji chako: maendeleo yanapotea ukurasa huu ukifungwa. Tumia dirisha la kawaida (si la faragha), au nakili msimbo wa hifadhi kwenye Mipangilio.

ui.this_browser_may_delete_this_village_.en: This browser may delete this village if you stay away for a while. To keep it: install Kagemura (the browser menu → Install app or Add to Home screen), link a sign-in under Online play, or copy a save code.
ui.this_browser_may_delete_this_village_.text: Kivinjari hiki kinaweza kufuta kijiji hiki ukikaa mbali kwa muda. Ili kukibakiza: sakinisha Kagemura (menyu ya kivinjari → Sakinisha programu au Ongeza kwenye skrini ya mwanzo), unganisha njia ya kuingia katika Kucheza mtandaoni, au nakili msimbo wa hifadhi.

ui.this_browser_may_delete_your_village_.en: This browser may delete your village if you stay away for a week.
ui.this_browser_may_delete_your_village_.text: Kivinjari hiki kinaweza kufuta kijiji chako ukikaa mbali kwa wiki moja.

ui.this_browser_mode_cannot_save_your_vi.en: This browser mode cannot save. Your village will be lost when you close the page.
ui.this_browser_mode_cannot_save_your_vi.text: Hali hii ya kivinjari haiwezi kuhifadhi. Kijiji chako kitapotea ukifunga ukurasa.

ui.this_device_could_not_store_your_late.en: This device could not store your latest actions (storage full or blocked). They are being sent to the server now; free some space to keep playing offline safely.
ui.this_device_could_not_store_your_late.text: Kifaa hiki hakikuweza kuhifadhi vitendo vyako vya karibuni (hifadhi imejaa au imezuiwa). Vinatumwa kwa seva sasa; ondoa vitu ili kupata nafasi na kuendelea kucheza nje ya mtandao kwa usalama.

ui.this_device_still_holds_your_online_a.en: This device still holds your online account on
ui.this_device_still_holds_your_online_a.text: Kifaa hiki bado kina akaunti yako ya mtandaoni kwenye

ui.this_device_will_play_the_account_lin.en: This device will play the account linked to that sign-in. If its village is kept on the server, it replaces the village here, which stays as a backup in Settings. Your current online account is not deleted.
ui.this_device_will_play_the_account_lin.text: Kifaa hiki kitacheza akaunti iliyounganishwa na njia hiyo ya kuingia. Ikiwa kijiji chake kinahifadhiwa kwenye seva, kinachukua nafasi ya kijiji kilicho hapa, ambacho kinabaki kama nakala ya akiba kwenye Mipangilio. Akaunti yako ya sasa ya mtandaoni haifutwi.

ui.this_is_a_server_for_testing_villages.en: This is a {arg1} server for testing: villages and purchases here are separate from the real game.
ui.this_is_a_server_for_testing_villages.text: Hii ni seva ya {arg1} kwa majaribio: vijiji na manunuzi hapa ni tofauti na mchezo halisi.

ui.this_is_the_testing_sandbox_a_separat.en: This is the testing sandbox: a separate practice village with online play off. Skipping time moves the sandbox clock ahead for good; your real village is never affected.
ui.this_is_the_testing_sandbox_a_separat.text: Hili ni eneo la majaribio: kijiji tofauti cha mazoezi ambapo kucheza mtandaoni kumezimwa. Kuruka muda husogeza mbele saa ya eneo la majaribio kabisa; kijiji chako halisi hakiathiriwi kamwe.

ui.this_starts_a_new_village_that_is_kep.en: This starts a new village that is kept on the server. The village on this device stays as a backup you can restore in Settings.
ui.this_starts_a_new_village_that_is_kep.text: Hii inaanzisha kijiji kipya kinachohifadhiwa kwenye seva. Kijiji kilicho kwenye kifaa hiki kinabaki kama nakala ya akiba unayoweza kurejesha kwenye Mipangilio.

ui.time_skips_and_test_purchases_live_in.en: Time skips and test purchases live in a separate testing sandbox, so they can never change your real village or online play.
ui.time_skips_and_test_purchases_live_in.text: Kuruka muda na manunuzi ya majaribio hukaa katika eneo tofauti la majaribio, kwa hiyo haviwezi kamwe kubadilisha kijiji chako halisi wala kucheza mtandaoni.

ui.time_until_everyone_who_fits_in_the_s.en: Time until everyone who fits in the Squad Courtyards has finished
ui.time_until_everyone_who_fits_in_the_s.text: Muda hadi kila anayetosha katika Viwanja vya Kikosi amalize

ui.train_some_warriors_first_duels_use_y.en: Train some warriors first: duels use your army (none are spent).
ui.train_some_warriors_first_duels_use_y.text: Kwanza funza wapiganaji kadhaa: mapambano hutumia jeshi lako (hakuna anayetumika).

ui.train_some_warriors_then_save_the_mix.en: Train some warriors, then save the mix here to refill it later.
ui.train_some_warriors_then_save_the_mix.text: Funza wapiganaji kadhaa, kisha uhifadhi mchanganyiko hapa ili kuujaza tena baadaye.

ui.trained_ahead_they_join_your_army_whe.en: Trained ahead. They join your army when the Squad Courtyards have room. Jade can't finish them until then.
ui.trained_ahead_they_join_your_army_whe.text: Wamefunzwa mapema. Watajiunga na jeshi lako Viwanja vya Kikosi vikiwa na nafasi. Jade haiwezi kuwamaliza hadi wakati huo.

ui.training_opens_as_soon_as_the_work_is.en: Training opens as soon as the work is done.
ui.training_opens_as_soon_as_the_work_is.text: Mafunzo yanafunguka mara tu kazi ikikamilika.

ui.two_to_four_friends_against_another_g.en: Two to four friends against another Gang of the same size: 2 hours to prepare, then 22 hours with 2 attacks each. Strike alone, or relay: a relay strike starts from half the damage of your Gang’s last strike on that base (defenders patch up in between). No honor is won or lost; everyone gets a chest.
ui.two_to_four_friends_against_another_g.text: Marafiki wawili hadi wanne dhidi ya Genge jingine la ukubwa sawa: saa 2 za kujiandaa, kisha saa 22 zenye mashambulio 2 kila mmoja. Piga peke yako, au kwa kupokezana: pigo la kupokezana huanza kutoka nusu ya madhara ya pigo la mwisho la Genge lako kwenye kambi hiyo (walinzi hurekebisha katikati). Hakuna heshima inayoshindwa wala kupotea; kila mtu anapata kasha.

ui.until_the_season_ends_20_faster_build.en: Until the season ends: {pct}% faster builds, the {arg1} look and bigger rewards on every tier. Rewards you already earned unlock right away.
ui.until_the_season_ends_20_faster_build.text: Hadi msimu uishe: ujenzi wa haraka zaidi kwa {pct}%, mwonekano wa {arg1} na zawadi kubwa zaidi kwenye kila daraja. Zawadi ulizokwisha pata zinafunguka mara moja.

ui.update_kagemura_from_then_open_it_aga.en: Update Kagemura from {arg1}, then open it again.
ui.update_kagemura_from_then_open_it_aga.text: Sasisha Kagemura kutoka {arg1}, kisha uifungue tena.

ui.upgrading_your_clan_keep_to_level_unl.en: Upgrading your Clan Keep to level {arg1} unlocks:
ui.upgrading_your_clan_keep_to_level_unl.text: Kuboresha Ngome yako ya Ukoo hadi ngazi {arg1} kunafungua:

ui.village_map_drag_to_look_around_pinch.en: Village map. Drag to look around, pinch or scroll to zoom, tap a building to select it. Every action is also on the buttons around the map.
ui.village_map_drag_to_look_around_pinch.text: Ramani ya kijiji. Buruta ili kuangalia pande zote, bana au sogeza ili kukuza, gusa jengo ili kulichagua. Kila kitendo kiko pia kwenye vitufe vinavyozunguka ramani.

ui.warriors_need_two_buildings_the_dojo_.en: Warriors need two buildings: the Dojo trains them and the Courtyard houses them.
ui.warriors_need_two_buildings_the_dojo_.text: Wapiganaji wanahitaji majengo mawili: Dojo huwafunza na Uwanja huwahifadhi.

ui.we_keep_only_an_age_group_on_this_dev.en: We keep only an age group on this device and our server, never your date of birth. Please answer honestly: our support team can correct a mistake.
ui.we_keep_only_an_age_group_on_this_dev.text: Tunahifadhi kundi la umri pekee kwenye kifaa hiki na seva yetu, kamwe si tarehe yako ya kuzaliwa. Tafadhali jibu kwa ukweli: timu yetu ya usaidizi inaweza kurekebisha kosa.

ui.when_the_game_hits_an_error_it_sends_.en: When the game hits an error, it sends the error message, where in the code it happened, the game version and the platform, to help fix it. It does not add your name, Player ID, village or chat, but an error message can sometimes include text the game was working on.
ui.when_the_game_hits_an_error_it_sends_.text: Mchezo ukikumbana na hitilafu, hutuma ujumbe wa hitilafu, mahali katika msimbo ilipotokea, toleo la mchezo na jukwaa, ili kusaidia kuirekebisha. Hauongezi jina lako, Kitambulisho cha Mchezaji, kijiji wala gumzo, lakini ujumbe wa hitilafu wakati mwingine unaweza kuwa na maandishi ambayo mchezo ulikuwa ukishughulikia.

ui.when_the_last_of_this_stack_finishes_.en: When the last of this stack finishes, after everyone ahead of it
ui.when_the_last_of_this_stack_finishes_.text: Wa mwisho wa kundi hili atakapomaliza, baada ya wote walio mbele yake

ui.where_you_live_google_play_confirms_a.en: Where you live, Google Play confirms ages for apps. Open the Play Store app, verify your age there, then come back: online play and purchases unlock once Google Play shares your age group.
ui.where_you_live_google_play_confirms_a.text: Mahali unapoishi, Google Play huthibitisha umri kwa programu. Fungua programu ya Play Store, thibitisha umri wako huko, kisha urudi: kucheza mtandaoni na ununuzi vinafunguka Google Play ikishashiriki kundi lako la umri.

ui.where_you_live_the_app_store_confirms.en: Where you live, the App Store confirms ages for apps. Confirm your age in your Apple Account settings, then come back.
ui.where_you_live_the_app_store_confirms.text: Mahali unapoishi, App Store huthibitisha umri kwa programu. Thibitisha umri wako kwenye mipangilio ya Akaunti yako ya Apple, kisha urudi.

ui.who_can_find_me_by_name_ed481ead6d.en: Who can find me by name

ui.win_raids_to_earn_honor_lose_it_when_.en: Win raids to earn honor; lose it when your attacks fail or when raiders beat your village. More honor bring tougher opponents with more loot.
ui.win_raids_to_earn_honor_lose_it_when_.text: Shinda mavamizi ili kupata heshima; unaipoteza mashambulio yako yanaposhindwa au wavamizi wanaposhinda kijiji chako. Heshima zaidi huleta wapinzani wagumu zaidi wenye nyara zaidi.

ui.you_are_about_to_spend_of_real_money_.en: You are about to spend {arg1} of real money. Make sure a parent or guardian says it's OK.
ui.you_are_about_to_spend_of_real_money_.text: Unakaribia kutumia pesa halisi: {arg1}. Hakikisha mzazi au mlezi amekubali.

ui.you_are_in_the_top_league_8b390ac669.en: You are in the top league!
ui.you_are_in_the_top_league_8b390ac669.text: Uko kwenye ligi ya juu kabisa!

ui.you_are_number_with_power_3a4362c773.text: Wewe ni nambari {arg1}, ukiwa na nguvu {arg2}.

ui.you_are_playing_on_your_own_opponents.en: You are playing on your own: opponents, raiders and your Alliance are friendly bots (always labelled as computer players). To raid real players and join real Alliances, enter a Kagemura: Ninja Clans server address under Advanced, below.
ui.you_are_playing_on_your_own_opponents.text: Unacheza peke yako: wapinzani, wavamizi na Muungano wako ni roboti za kirafiki (daima zina alama ya wachezaji wa kompyuta). Ili kuvamia wachezaji halisi na kujiunga na Miungano halisi, weka anwani ya seva ya Kagemura: Koo za Ninja katika Kina zaidi, hapa chini.

ui.you_can_add_each_other_again_later_01.en: You can add each other again later.

ui.you_can_found_or_join_a_gang_again_af.en: You can found or join a Gang again after 24 hours.
ui.you_can_found_or_join_a_gang_again_af.text: Unaweza kuanzisha au kujiunga na Genge tena baada ya saa 24.

ui.you_can_join_another_alliance_straigh.en: You can join another Alliance straight away. Warriors in your Alliance Lodge stay with you.
ui.you_can_join_another_alliance_straigh.text: Unaweza kujiunga na Muungano mwingine mara moja. Wapiganaji walio kwenye Ukumbi wako wa Muungano wanabaki nawe.

ui.you_can_keep_saved_armies_delete_one_.en: You can keep {arg1} saved armies. Delete one to save this army.
ui.you_can_keep_saved_armies_delete_one_.text: Unaweza kuhifadhi majeshi {arg1}. Futa moja ili kuhifadhi jeshi hili.

ui.you_finished_the_training_please_ente.en: You finished the training. Please enter your year of birth: it sets the right protections for your age (spending limits, offers, and for online play who can find you and how you chat).
ui.you_finished_the_training_please_ente.text: Umemaliza mafunzo ya mwanzo. Tafadhali weka mwaka wako wa kuzaliwa: unaweka kinga sahihi kwa umri wako (vikomo vya matumizi, ofa, na kwa kucheza mtandaoni nani anaweza kukupata na jinsi unavyozungumza).

ui.you_have_not_cleared_a_tier_yet_cb231.en: You have not cleared a tier yet.

ui.you_have_the_premium_season_scroll_th.en: You have the premium Season Scroll this season.
ui.you_have_the_premium_season_scroll_th.text: Una Gombo la Msimu la kulipia msimu huu.

ui.you_joined_after_this_war_started_che.en: You joined after this war started: cheer your Gang on.
ui.you_joined_after_this_war_started_che.text: Ulijiunga baada ya vita hivi kuanza: shangilia Genge lako.

ui.you_left_a_gang_lately_you_can_found_.en: You left a Gang lately: you can found or join one in {arg1}.
ui.you_left_a_gang_lately_you_can_found_.text: Uliondoka kwenye Genge hivi karibuni: unaweza kuanzisha au kujiunga na jingine baada ya {arg1}.

ui.you_ll_get_back_of_what_you_paid_5919.en: You'll get back {arg1}% of what you paid.

ui.you_stop_being_friends_and_neither_of.en: You stop being friends, and neither of you can find or ask the other.
ui.you_stop_being_friends_and_neither_of.text: Mnaacha kuwa marafiki, na hakuna kati yenu atakayeweza kumtafuta au kumwomba mwenzake.

ui.your_age_group_can_only_be_made_stric.en: Your age group can only be made stricter here. To correct it, contact support from Settings → Privacy and help.
ui.your_age_group_can_only_be_made_stric.text: Kundi lako la umri linaweza tu kufanywa kali zaidi hapa. Kulirekebisha, wasiliana na usaidizi kutoka Mipangilio → Faragha na msaada.

ui.your_alliance_is_matched_with_a_real_.en: Your Alliance is matched with a real Alliance of similar size and strength, or with a band of wild bots when none is free. Only members who were in the Alliance when the raid starts take part.
ui.your_alliance_is_matched_with_a_real_.text: Muungano wako unalinganishwa na Muungano halisi wa ukubwa na nguvu zinazofanana, au na kundi la roboti za porini pasipo uliopo huru. Wanachama waliokuwa katika Muungano uvamizi unapoanza pekee ndio wanaoshiriki.

ui.your_clan_keep_is_at_the_highest_leve.en: Your Clan Keep is at the highest level available right now.
ui.your_clan_keep_is_at_the_highest_leve.text: Ngome yako ya Ukoo iko kwenye ngazi ya juu kabisa inayopatikana sasa.

ui.your_current_layout_is_now_your_duel_.en: Your current layout is now your duel layout.
ui.your_current_layout_is_now_your_duel_.text: Mpangilio wako wa sasa sasa ndio mpangilio wako wa pambano.

ui.your_current_village_on_this_device_w.en: Your current village on this device will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
ui.your_current_village_on_this_device_w.text: Kijiji chako cha sasa kwenye kifaa hiki kitafutwa. Hili haliwezi kutenduliwa.

ui.your_earlier_village_is_back_the_one_.en: Your earlier village is back. The one you were playing is kept in Settings.
ui.your_earlier_village_is_back_the_one_.text: Kijiji chako cha awali kimerudi. Kile ulichokuwa ukicheza kimehifadhiwa kwenye Mipangilio.

ui.your_earlier_village_is_safe_f15d817e.text: Kijiji chako cha awali kiko salama

ui.your_first_raid_tap_attack_when_you_a.en: Your first raid. Tap Attack! when you are ready.
ui.your_first_raid_tap_attack_when_you_a.text: Uvamizi wako wa kwanza. Gonga Shambulia! ukiwa tayari.

ui.your_friend_code_always_works_share_i.en: Your friend code always works: share it only with people you want to add.
ui.your_friend_code_always_works_share_i.text: Msimbo wako wa rafiki hufanya kazi kila mara: uushiriki tu na watu unaotaka kuwaongeza.

ui.your_leader_starts_gang_wars_fe4ca360.text: Kiongozi wako huanzisha Vita vya Genge.

ui.your_new_village_is_kept_on_the_serve.en: Your new village is kept on the server.
ui.your_new_village_is_kept_on_the_serve.text: Kijiji chako kipya kinahifadhiwa kwenye seva.

ui.your_on_was_interrupted_and_has_been_.en: Your {arg1} on {arg2} was interrupted and has been played out: {arg3}★, {arg4}%. See the battle log.
ui.your_on_was_interrupted_and_has_been_.text: Mchezo wako ({arg1}) dhidi ya {arg2} ulikatizwa na umechezwa hadi mwisho: {arg3}★, {arg4}%. Angalia kumbukumbu za vita.

ui.your_online_account_was_deleted_resta.en: Your online account was deleted. Restarting offline…
ui.your_online_account_was_deleted_resta.text: Akaunti yako ya mtandaoni imefutwa. Inaanza upya nje ya mtandao…

ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.en: Your player name, shared base, Alliance membership, chat messages and warrior requests are deleted from the server now. Online attacks still waiting for the server become practice results. Online play turns off on this device; your village stays. This cannot be undone.
ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.text: Jina lako la mchezaji, kambi iliyoshirikiwa, uanachama wa Muungano, jumbe za gumzo na maombi ya wapiganaji vinafutwa kwenye seva sasa. Mashambulio ya mtandaoni ambayo bado yanasubiri seva yanakuwa matokeo ya mazoezi. Kucheza mtandaoni kunazimwa kwenye kifaa hiki; kijiji chako kinabaki. Hili haliwezi kutenduliwa.

ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.en: Your player name, shared base, Alliance and Gang membership, friends, chat messages and any village kept on {arg1} are deleted from that server now. Online play stays off; your village on this device stays. This cannot be undone.
ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.text: Jina lako la mchezaji, kambi iliyoshirikiwa, uanachama wa Muungano na Genge, marafiki, jumbe za gumzo na kijiji chochote kilichohifadhiwa kwenye {arg1} vinafutwa kwenye seva hiyo sasa. Kucheza mtandaoni kunabaki kumezimwa; kijiji chako kwenye kifaa hiki kinabaki. Hili haliwezi kutenduliwa.

ui.your_purchase_is_here_but_this_device.en: Your purchase is here, but this device could not save it (storage full?). Free some space: it stays open in the store and is delivered again if needed.
ui.your_purchase_is_here_but_this_device.text: Ununuzi wako umefika, lakini kifaa hiki hakikuweza kuuhifadhi (hifadhi imejaa?). Pata nafasi: unabaki wazi dukani na utawasilishwa tena ikihitajika.

ui.your_remaining_troops_go_back_home_yo.en: Your remaining warriors go back home. You keep any loot you already won.
ui.your_remaining_troops_go_back_home_yo.text: Wapiganaji wako waliobaki wanarudi nyumbani. Unabaki na nyara zozote ulizokwisha shinda.

ui.your_stars_count_toward_the_alliance_.en: Your stars count toward the Alliance War.
ui.your_stars_count_toward_the_alliance_.text: Nyota zako zinahesabiwa katika Vita vya Muungano.

ui.your_training_dojo_trains_faster_than.en: Your Training Dojo trains {arg1}× faster than a level 1 Dojo.
ui.your_training_dojo_trains_faster_than.text: Dojo yako ya Mafunzo hufunza kwa kasi mara {arg1} kuliko Dojo ya ngazi 1.

ui.your_village_could_not_be_saved_free_.en: Your village could not be saved ({arg1}). Free some device storage, and copy a save code in Settings to keep it safe.
ui.your_village_could_not_be_saved_free_.text: Kijiji chako hakikuweza kuhifadhiwa ({arg1}). Pata nafasi kwenye hifadhi ya kifaa, na unakili msimbo wa hifadhi kwenye Mipangilio ili kukiweka salama.

ui.your_village_is_kept_on_the_server_ev.en: Your village is kept on the server: every change to its resources, buildings, army and research is checked there, so it cannot be lost with this device. What you do is sent as you play; while offline it waits and goes when you reconnect.
ui.your_village_is_kept_on_the_server_ev.text: Kijiji chako kinahifadhiwa kwenye seva: kila badiliko la rasilimali zake, majengo, jeshi na utafiti hukaguliwa huko, kwa hiyo hakiwezi kupotea pamoja na kifaa hiki. Unachofanya hutumwa unapocheza; ukiwa nje ya mtandao kinasubiri na kutumwa ukiunganisha tena.

ui.your_village_is_now_kept_on_the_serve.en: Your village is now kept on the server.
ui.your_village_is_now_kept_on_the_serve.text: Kijiji chako sasa kinahifadhiwa kwenye seva.

ui.your_village_is_on_the_server_now_cou.en: Your village is on the server now. {arg1} could not be matched to a purchase we checked, so it is held for review: contact support from Settings. Your old village is kept as a backup.
ui.your_village_is_on_the_server_now_cou.text: Kijiji chako sasa kiko kwenye seva. Kuna kitu ({arg1}) ambacho hakikuweza kulinganishwa na ununuzi tuliokagua, kwa hiyo kimezuiliwa kwa ukaguzi: wasiliana na usaidizi kutoka Mipangilio. Kijiji chako cha zamani kimehifadhiwa kama nakala ya akiba.

ui.your_village_is_saved_and_your_artisa.en: Your village is saved, and your Artisans keep working while you are away.
ui.your_village_is_saved_and_your_artisa.text: Kijiji chako kimehifadhiwa, na Mafundi wako wanaendelea kufanya kazi ukiwa mbali.

ui.your_village_moves_to_the_server_as_i.en: Your village moves to the server as it is, if it is a village its Keep could really have. From then on every change is checked there, and you can play it on other devices by linking a sign-in.
ui.your_village_moves_to_the_server_as_i.text: Kijiji chako kinahamia kwenye seva kama kilivyo, ikiwa ni kijiji ambacho Ngome yake ingeweza kuwa nacho kweli. Kuanzia hapo kila badiliko hukaguliwa huko, na unaweza kukicheza kwenye vifaa vingine kwa kuunganisha njia ya kuingia.

ui.your_village_saves_automatically_on_t.en: Your village saves automatically on this device. To move it to another device, copy a save code here and load it there.
ui.your_village_saves_automatically_on_t.text: Kijiji chako hujihifadhi chenyewe kwenye kifaa hiki. Kukihamishia kifaa kingine, nakili msimbo wa hifadhi hapa na uupakie huko.

ui.your_village_was_opened_in_another_ta.en: Your village was opened in another tab or window, and only one can save it. Your progress is safe there.
ui.your_village_was_opened_in_another_ta.text: Kijiji chako kilifunguliwa katika kichupo au dirisha jingine, na kimoja tu kinaweza kukihifadhi. Maendeleo yako yako salama huko.

ui.your_village_was_saved_by_a_newer_ver.en: Your village was saved by a newer version of Kagemura, so this version cannot open it. It is safe and unchanged.
ui.your_village_was_saved_by_a_newer_ver.text: Kijiji chako kilihifadhiwa na toleo jipya zaidi la Kagemura, kwa hiyo toleo hili haliwezi kukifungua. Kiko salama na hakijabadilika.

ui.your_war_base_now_matches_your_villag.en: Your war base now matches your village.
ui.your_war_base_now_matches_your_villag.text: Kambi yako ya vita sasa inalingana na kijiji chako.

extra.53d75daa54.text: Hakuna nafasi wazi kwa jengo hilo.

extra.a0ce7f563a.en: Towers in a wide ring cover each other: jam one, smoke your squad as it reaches the next, break in through the gap.
extra.a0ce7f563a.text: Minara iliyopangwa katika duara pana hulindana: kwamisha mmoja, funika kikosi chako kwa moshi kinapofika mnara unaofuata, ingia kupitia pengo.

extra.1abbbc94b0.en: Two closed walls: Saboteurs and Tunnel Runners slip in, Guardians break through.
extra.1abbbc94b0.text: Kuta mbili zilizofungwa: Wahujumu na Wakimbiaji wa Handaki hupenya, Walinzi huzivunja.

extra.4797c296e4.en: Firework Mortars guard the centre: jam them before the main force arrives, and spread out.

extra.8e339fb4f5.en: Two gates funnel warriors onto hidden traps: choose a gate, or go over the wall.

extra.ab7daf1525.en: Buildings spread wide with no walls: fast Shinobi and Tunnel Runners clear it quickly.
extra.ab7daf1525.text: Majengo yametawanyika bila kuta: Shinobi wepesi na Wakimbiaji wa Handaki huyamaliza haraka.
